summary: Singleton of esv::inventory::SummoningSystem (macOS writer SummoningSystem::ProcessReequipUpdates; Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xF2AB60, game copy bg3.exe+0x35087A0 paired 0.23; GatherSummonRequests EoCServer.dll+0xF29D10 ~ bg3.exe+0x3507FA0). Holds two request arrays: summon requests (0xE0 bytes each) and re-equip requests (0x110 bytes each). Alive everywhere (idle), seen empty. Element members beyond the first entity are a variant/optional payload not decoded.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: variant storage (raw: the alternatives overlay each other). Windows: the array resize bg3.exe+0x22E29E0 calls bg3.exe+0x22D5900 on element+0x10 when the index byte at element+0xD8 == 3; for that alternative bg3.exe+0x22D5900 shows an optional FixedString at element+0x24 (has-value byte element+0x28, DecRef unless -1) and an optional object at element+0x30 (has-value byte element+0xC8, destroyed by bg3.exe+0x21BCD00). Other alternatives are trivially destructible and not decoded.

fields.name: field_d8
fields.evidence: variant index of the payload at +0x10 (compared with 3 before destruction).

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Toolkit ProcessReequipUpdates walks comp+0x10 with stride 0x110 and compares *(u64*)element with the character entity it is re-equipping.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: payload copied with FUN_180f28f00(&local, element+8) and released with FUN_180f29550; bg3.exe+0x22E2CD0 destroys element+0x28 when the byte at element+0x108 == 1. Contains the target item entity (compared with the item found by eoc::equipment::GetEquipmentEntityInSlot).

fields.name: field_108
fields.evidence: variant index / has-value byte of the payload (compared with 1).

fields.name: SummonRequests
fields.evidence: destructor bg3.exe+0x22D0470: bg3.exe+0x22E29E0(comp+0, 0) (element stride 0xE0) then free. Adder bg3.exe+0x3509EF0 zeroes both arrays.

fields.name: ReequipRequests
fields.evidence: destructor: bg3.exe+0x22E2CD0(comp+0x10, 0) (element stride 0x110) then free. Toolkit ProcessReequipUpdates iterates comp+0x10 / size comp+0x1C with stride 0x110 and appends new entries there (FUN_180f266a0).

open_questions: Members of both element structs beyond the strides (0xE0, 0x110), the variant index at +0xD8 and the optional flag at +0x108; the alternatives of the 0xE0 element's variant (only alternative 3 is partly known: optional FixedString at +0x24, optional object at +0x30). Toolkit GatherSummonRequests (EoCServer.dll+0xF29D10) fills the system's FrameData, not the component, so it does not name them.
Which array is summon vs re-equip rests on ProcessReequipUpdates using the 0x110 one.
status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
second_pass: Re-read the Windows element destructors (bg3.exe+0x22E29E0 / 0x22D5900 for the 0xE0 element, bg3.exe+0x22E2CD0 for the 0x110 one): the strides, the variant index byte (+0xD8) and the optional flag (+0x108) are confirmed, but no writer on the Windows or Toolkit side names the element members, so the layout stays low.
